tool_schemas.name: list_invoices
tool_schemas.description: List invoices, optionally for one vendor (by vendor name).

tool_schemas.name: send_wire
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by wire from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: send_ach
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by ACH from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: list_payments
tool_schemas.description: List payments sent from the operating account.

tool_schemas.name: link_payment
tool_schemas.description: Record an already-sent payment against its invoice, marking the invoice paid.

Done — Borealis Freight has been paid exactly once.

**Payment report**
- **Vendor:** Borealis Freight (V-271), bank-verified; wire rail available and used
- **Invoice paid:** INV-92094 — $1,261.68, due 2026-11-04
- **Rail:** Wire from the operating account
- **Payment ID:** PAY0001 — status "sent"
- **Idempotency key:** INV-92094-V271-wire (guards against a duplicate send)
- Invoice INV-92094 now shows **paid**; payments ledger contains exactly one entry (PAY0001)

**Notes / what I deliberately did not pay**
- **INV-92094-B ($1,261.68)** — approved but its memo reads "Duplicate submission of INV-92094 – do not pay." Same amount and due date as INV-92094, so I treated it as a duplicate and left it unpaid. It remains in approved status, so someone may want to void or close it out to prevent an accidental future payment.
- **INV-18748 ($8,449.51)** — still in draft ("Awaiting approval"), so not payable yet.
- **INV-82376 ($1,696.28)** — already paid previously.

No amounts here exceeded the $10,000 controller-approval threshold, so no approval escalation was needed.
